author: ReyCassie
body:
dear Avicus staff,

i got temp banned for spawn killing for 10 days. One I think 10 days is very harsh. And 2 I was kill farming just beyond the cross section. I admit I went in the cross section for like 1 second but I wasn't spawn killing there.

please take my appeal in consideration 

regards nemo

title: My appeal

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

Nemo I have decided to deny your appeal. After days of testing/observing the staff team found that you regularly crossed the border while kill farming. This led to the severity of your temp ban. Also after looking at your infraction page I recommend you tread carefully only a few more infractions until you could be punished again.

Thanks,
Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
